lines.text: After a week in Glacier, Jake drove north to Banff with his U.S. annual park pass on the dashboard.
At the Canadian park gate, he learned it only works in U.S. parks.
Canada's national parks need their own Parks Canada pass, bought online or at the gate.
Check fees and reservations for both parks before you go,
and carry passports for the border.
Next summer, both passes were ready.
